subject: Assignment packet + reviewer roster for Senior Infra SWE candidate
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@gmail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Assignment packet + reviewer roster for Senior Infra SWE candidate

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. As discussed, attached is the take-home assignment for the Senior Infrastructure SWE role. Quick summary:

- What: implement a small batching service + short performance writeup (infra_takehome.pdf)
- Deliverables: code + README + short writeup (see rubric for evaluation criteria)
- Deadline: Friday, 2027-03-12 11:59 PM PT (we can adjust if you need extra time)
- How to submit: reply to this thread with a link to a zip or a GitHub repo; include any run instructions

I've cc'd our hiring reviewer coordinator (Dev) and Marissa from Recruiting to help with scheduling peer reviews. Dev will post reviewer slots we can pick from — reviewers will read submissions and join a 45-min async debrief window next week.

Attachments:
- infra_takehome.pdf (prompt)
- evaluation_rubric.md (grading criteria)
- reviewer_slots.ics (tentative reviewer block times)

Can you reply to confirm you received this and whether the deadline works? If you need an extension, say so and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

--
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.com
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@gmail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: recruiting@talentbridge.io
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 18:47:23 -0400
Subject: Re: Assignment packet + reviewer roster for Senior Infra SWE candidate

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the packet and the clear rubric. I got all three attachments and will start today. The deadline works for me in general, but I wanted to ask for a 48-hour extension if possible — I'm traveling for a family commitment and will have limited laptop time until Sunday evening PT. If an extension complicates reviewer scheduling, I can still aim for the Friday deadline, but wanted to check availability for Monday 3/15 end-of-day as a fallback.

Also: is there an expected max LOC for the code submission? I want to make sure the scope matches expectations.

Thanks!
Samantha

--
Samantha Nguyen
Frontend/Infra Engineer (candidate)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@gmail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assignment packet + reviewer roster for Senior Infra SWE candidate

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up and absolutely yes, we can extend to Monday 2027-03-15 11:59 PM PT. That won't block the process — we'll shift reviewer reads and the debrief window accordingly.

Regarding LOC: no hard limit. We care about correctness, testability, and clarity. Keep it focussed (20–300 lines is totally fine depending on language) and include a README with run steps and any assumptions.

Dev / Marissa — can you move reviewer slots and confirm the new async debrief window? Ideally reviewers should have 48 hours to read before the debrief; please propose slots and share a Calendly/ICS.

Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform

On it. I've reserved three reviewer slots and pinged the review panel (Marcus Lin, Karthik Iyer, and Hannah Schmitt) to cover different perspectives (performance, reliability, infra). Proposed read window: Mon 3/15 09:00–12:00 PT; debrief blocks: Mon 3/15 13:00–13:45 PT and Tue 3/16 09:00–09:45 PT (pick one).

Shared links:
- Reviewer guide + short checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2ExampleDriveLink

I'll follow up once Marcus/Hannah confirm.

Thanks,
Dev
